description: Median value of owner-occupied homes, as estimated by the people who own them.

source.dataset: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B25077 (2020–2024)

howToRead: Owners' own estimates, not sale prices. They track market prices but tend to run a little high.
Each year is a 5-year average: "2024" covers 2020–2024. Compare periods that don't overlap for the clearest trend.
title: Median home value by county
caveats: Dollar amounts are in each period's final-year dollars, not adjusted to today.
Survey estimates: small counties have wide margins of error, so modest differences there are often noise.
Connecticut replaced its counties with planning regions in 2022, so it appears as no data on the county map.
